hero.description: Vasool App is a Daily, Weekly and Monthly based online finance collection software for micro finance industry. Gold loan, property loan, live tracking, route planning, and analytics—all in one powerful system.

allFeatures.description: From loan origination to collection tracking, staff management to multi-tenant deployment—our platform covers every aspect of microfinance operations.

loans.description: Specialized loan management for every collection cycle — daily, weekly, monthly, gold loan, property loan, and product-based — with complete lifecycle tools.

daily.title: Daily Loans
daily.desc: Small loans repaid through daily collections by field agents visiting customers on their assigned routes.

weekly.title: Weekly Loans
weekly.desc: Loans with weekly repayment cycles — ideal for borrowers with weekly income patterns like market vendors.

gold.title: Gold Loans
gold.desc: Loans secured against gold ornaments — manage valuation, pledging, interest calculation, and redemption with complete tracking.
gold.h1: Gold item cataloging with weight & purity

property.title: Property Loans
property.desc: Loans secured against property — manage valuation, document verification, disbursement, and flexible repayment schedules.

product.title: Product-Based Loans
product.desc: Loans tied to physical products — customers purchase goods with financing, repaying via daily or weekly collections.

features.description: From customer management to multi-tenant infrastructure, Vasool covers every aspect of running a microfinance business.

customer.title: Customer Management
customer.desc: Full customer profiles with KYC documents, GPS locations, contact history, and staff/referee linking.

route.title: Route Management
route.desc: Plan daily and weekly collection routes, assign to staff, and track completion with real-time totals.

reporting.title: Reporting & Analytics
reporting.desc: 9 report types including P&L, officer performance, collection summaries, and overdue tracking.

security.title: Security & Audit
security.desc: JWT auth, biometric login, audit logging, bot protection, and rate limiting — built into every deployment.

multiTenancy.title: Multi-Tenancy
multiTenancy.desc: Isolated tenant environments with custom branding, feature toggles, storage limits, and automated provisioning.

api.title: API & Integration
api.desc: REST, gRPC, and gRPC-Web APIs with Swagger docs and offline sync support for mobile clients.

staff.description: Give your team the tools they need to manage customers, track expenses, and collect payments efficiently — right from their phone.
staff.bullet1: Dedicated mobile app for field agents

mobile.title: Mobile App
mobile.desc: Android app with one-handed UI for daily collections, customer visits, and route navigation.

gps.title: GPS Tracking
gps.desc: Real-time location tracking and historical GPS trail for field visit verification.

expense.title: Expense Management
expense.desc: Log expenses with receipt photos. Admin approval workflow for reimbursements.

rbac.title: Access Control
rbac.desc: Custom roles with granular permissions. Control what each staff role can access.

offline.title: Offline Mode
offline.desc: Record collections without internet. Syncs automatically when connectivity returns.

biometric.title: Biometric Login
biometric.desc: Fingerprint and face recognition for fast, secure authentication on mobile devices.

cta.description: Take control of your microfinance management with Vasool. Customized to fit your business needs, from customer onboarding to daily collections.

footer.description: Daily, Weekly and Monthly based online finance collection software for micro finance industry. Gold loan, property loan & live tracking.
